name: @catalystcommunity/tallyowl-browser
description: The TallyOwl browser package. It rides the host application's existing connection and never opens one of its own.
//: A published tarball carries `dist` and nothing else. The compiler puts the generated client and the CSIL transport under `dist` as well, because `rootDir` is the repository root, so an installed package needs no path outside itself. `./tools.sh release package` builds before it packs, and refuses a tarball that has no entry point.
